name: Authenticate field engineer
goal: Field Engineer logs into the application to obtain authorized access to his/her workspace.

name: View assigned sites
goal: Field Engineer views the list of sites that have been assigned to him/her for inspection.

name: Create inspection report draft
goal: Field Engineer creates a new inspection report, fills in the checklist, attaches photos, and saves the work as a draft on the device.

name: Submit completed inspection report
goal: Field Engineer finalises a previously‑saved draft, submits the inspection report and triggers system processing of the attached media.

name: Browse inspection reports
goal: Site Manager browses inspection reports, optionally filtering by site and date, to locate reports of interest.

name: View inspection report photos
goal: Site Manager opens a selected inspection report and views the photos that were attached to it.

name: Download inspection report PDF
goal: Site Manager downloads the PDF summary generated for a selected inspection report.

name: Flag inspection report for follow‑up
goal: Site Manager marks an inspection report as requiring follow‑up action.

name: View follow‑up requests
goal: Field Engineer sees any follow‑up requests that have been assigned to him/her when he/she signs in next.

name: Manage engineer accounts
goal: Administrator creates, modifies, or deactivates field‑engineer user accounts.

name: Assign engineers to sites
goal: Administrator assigns or reassigns field engineers to specific sites.

name: Perform nightly backup of inspection data
goal: Backup Storage Service receives and stores a nightly backup of the day’s inspection reports and associated photos, retaining them for the required period and ensuring they remain accessible after any service redeployment.
